newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil seen slightly up, nearby soymeal lower.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil seen slightly up, nearby soymeal lower.

text.p: Soybean products were expected to open mixed, with soyoil boosted early by follow-through buying, traders said.

On Monday, a late round of commodity fund buying pushed some contracts up more than 0.50 cent per lb. That rally was seen attracting additional buying early Tuesday. Futures were expected to open 0.05 to 0.10 cent per lb higher.
Nearby soymeal futures were expected to open $0.50 to $1.00 per ton lower, under pressure from losses in soybeans.
There was also talk that several cargos of unsold soymeal were headed for Rotterdam, traders said.
